<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex02032025-04-2514-36-50" status="finalized">de la <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsa ba</rs> dang</note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4294">khyung <note type="gloss">po grags se</note></rs> na re de byang chub seMs dpa'i yin pas rgyun du zhugs pa <abbr>la sogs</abbr> par gzhag pa'i chos ni myed mod kyi | de la <note type="gloss">byang seMs</note><note type="editorial">Reading "seMs" unclear</note> nyan thos rgyun du zhugs pa <abbr>la sogs</abbr> par btags pa yin no || de'i rgyu mtshan <lb edRef="inst:4454" n="82a7"/> ni 'jug pa dang ldog pa <note type="gloss">°°°°°° dang °°°° bzhin <abbr>med</abbr> par rtogs la byang seMs gyis <abbr>thams cad</abbr> rtogs pa'i</note> rtogs pa dang spangs pa <note type="gloss">nyon mongs pa'i dang nyes bya'i sgrib pa'i phyogs 1 spangs pa dang byang seMs kyis <abbr>tham cad</abbr> daM ci rigs pa spangs pas na</note> chung zad 'dra ba yod pas so ||            dgos pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha cig</rs> gi bsaM pa la dge 'dun bya ba ni skyes bu zung bzhi dang gang zag ya brgyad yin pas byang chub seMs dpa' la de'i don med do snyaM pa'i dogs pa bzlog pa'i don du yin no || 
          rngos la gnod pa ni mdo <note type="gloss"><rs type="work">shes phyin</rs> dang <rs type="work">phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i mdo'</rs></note> gnyis las byang chub seMs dpa'i dge 'dun du gsungs pa'i phyir ro zer ro ||</seg></TEI>
